evidence:
Scoped conclusion: the frozen golden plausibly covers all 133 Functional, 4 Polish, 5 Visual criteria and both gates. This is not an Oracle score or evidence of full configured evaluator completion. Workbook Quality Checks C19/D19 and Internal Quality Checks row19 contain the assigned plausibility bar; quality-checks.md:79-81 requires walking every criterion, especially arithmetic and seeded figures.

Functional coverage: task/solution/app/src/rules.js:41,54,62 and its composition/vesting/referral/headroom functions implement original-anchor UTC dates, exact BigInt half-up arithmetic, positive-spread intrinsic, distinct run-rate/band basis, separate vesting caps and ledger-derived balances. src/index.js:252,278,308,328,351,384 supplies validated create/revise/rescind operations, session roles, append-only settlement rows, snapshots and atomic eligibility checks; src/db.js supplies persistent one-time seeding. The 77 raw domain assertions pass, including the 9 tier-band cells, all role boundaries, lineage, date cliffs, relocation exclusion and real process replacement. Source bindings match the frozen task.

Coordinated coverage: src/change-sets.js:77-140 persists canonical saved intent, checks per-requisition append-only ledger versions (ABA), validates complete-set net budgets before writes, posts all member transitions in one immediate transaction, and returns cached original success at line98 before revalidating current leaves. Existing batch-domain/results.json has 15 passing groups; batch-boundaries/results.json adds distinct source-pair overlap, eligible draft authorization, changed source/destination/term keys, zero-unit successors and accepted maximum-safe units at zero spread. public/js/change-sets.js exposes ordinary forms, durable preview/history, commit and same-operation retry. batch-ui/results.json records stale-editor recovery and a real forwarded200 whose response is then lost, followed by successful original-operation retry.

Fresh independent browser run: row18-evidence/coverage.cjs ran in image sha256:a6e377e2468671fe2b676f3d211ca5c0cfdc4b68a98cffd1349b332ed59c6251 with the frozen task mounted read-only and networking disabled. Its 14 groups pass. In particular, the exact hro_money_precision UI probe uses base100 to101, one unit, relocation90071992547409.91 and fair/strike70368744177664.01; predecessor, successor and grant retain exact cents. A newly edited valid signing1.23 survives an over-budget revision refusal. The real rescission request is aborted once before dispatch, entered date is retained, and unchanged retry succeeds. results.json SHA256 644c9e248b32822867db6470a1633b18edcd0a1e32727f9d5cfddd5e3a713b67; driver SHA256 999f3423b9eecee82bc9b96b366038d74c8b5d4e29f3657db5451e5e829308f1.

Visual/gate coverage: observed desktop coordinated workspace, large-value offer economics, and Audit Trail show readable aligned labels/numbers, consistent palette/components, primary actions, and expandable stored receipts (row18-evidence screenshots; current local/batch-ui/committed-desktop.png). This supports plausible high visual credit, not an assigned Likert grade. Raw gate-witness evidence observes fresh saved requisition+pending-offer readback; exact installed MCP evidence establishes independent contexts, request concurrency and response interception; installer evidence records old PID21/new PID97 with saved data retained.

Evidence integrity/limits: all 84 current indexed artifact hashes and 94 source bindings checked without mismatch; row18-evidence/manifest.json records command, image and new artifact hashes. A balance-only freshness implementation could look correct on routine changes; the raw mutant witness fails at ABA (200 instead of409), while sequential-budget and missing-cache mutants fail their corresponding groups. The permitted empty-operational-seed variant passes the 15 coordinated groups, so golden-specific seed presence was not treated as proof that all alternative implementations would pass all criteria. No inability of the current golden to meet an owned criterion was identified. Local scripts do not supply the missing configured grade, judge duration, reward ordering or hosted outcome; those claims are outside this row verdict.
